cold_open: Three of this week's six games are championship rematches — five title games between them, from 2011 to 2024. It is the last week of the opening division run before the schedule crosses the lines.

notes.Brian Clark|Shawn: Clark's five straight from 2001 to 2006 is the longest run here; he once led by eight and has won four of the last five. Shawn took the last one, 77.83–72.89.
notes.Eric|Thomas: Seven meetings, Tom up 4–3. He took the last by 1.11 points, the closest they've ever played, and has won three of the last five. Neither has ever led by more than a game.
notes.Douglas|Steve Swanson: Doug beat Steve for the 2020 title and owns the biggest blowout in the series, 49.18 points in 2024. Steve leads 9–7 anyway, and won the last one 89.53–61.29.
notes.Evan|Fadi: Thirty-two meetings, two of them for the championship: Evan won in 2012, Fadi in 2024 by 0.12 points. Fadi has won four of the last five, and the series is dead even at 16–16.
notes.Jeff|Kevin Swanson: Swanson leads 10–3 and once led by eight. Jeff took the last one by 48.28 — the biggest blowout in the series, and only his third win in thirteen meetings.
notes.Dominic|Kevin O'Boyle: They've met twice for the title, and Dominic won both, in 2011 and 2021. O'Boyle leads the series 14–13 all the same, but Dominic won the last one, 76.17–55.41.

kicker: All six are division games, the last of the opening stretch. The cross-division schedule starts in Week 4.
